---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem

A clear and concise description of the problem you're trying to solve.
Example: "It bothers me that …"

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you considered.

## Use case

Who benefits from this and how? (e.g. "Anyone running both Claude Desktop and Cursor on macOS")

## Additional context

Mockups, links to related issues, references to other tools that do this well, etc.
